subject: general
question: By which river is the riverine island Majuli (Assam) formed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmaputra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Majuli' **is the **largest river island **in **the world**.
 
• **Majuli island **is a **large river island **located in the **middle **of the **'Brahmaputra River**' in **Assam**.
 
• **This island **was **formed **due to **a change in direction **of the **'Brahmaputra River**' and **its tributaries**.
 
• The **Brahmaputra river **origin from **the Manasarovar Lake **in **Tibet **and flow through **Tibet, India, and Bangladesh**.
 
• The **Godavari is **the **longest river **of **South India **it is known as **"The Ganges of the South".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Kaveri river **origin on **the Brahmagiri range **in the **Western Ghats**, of **Kodagu district **of the **state of Karnataka**.
 
• The **Narmada River**, also called the **Reva **and previously also known as **Narbada **or **anglicised **as **Nerbudda**, is the **5th longest river **and **overall longest west-flowing river in India**.
 
• The **Krishna River **is **a river **in the **Deccan plateau**, and **the third-longest river **of **India**, after the Ganges and Godavari, and **the fourth-largest **in terms of water inflows and river basin area in India
